svg.title: In particular this argument never presupposes that a discarded row has a good halo. For noise rows put ni = wirei. Their exact energy is bounded below by 1 2(√p ni −∥vi∥)2. On listed aisles the plot gives ni ≥wt. The uniform noise-response bound ∥vi∥≤Ct, together with C ≤√p w/2, therefore gives pn2 i /8 per listed aisle; all other noise rows remain nonnegative. The order of these choices matters. The response theorem supplies the common constant C before L is chosen and gives ε = C/L2. First take L large enough for the three displayed restrictions on ε; next take w ≥2C/√p; finally take the late scale parameter at those fixed values. The fine coefficient delivered by this construction is exactly a/128 > 0.
